propositions: src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py exceeds 500 LOC target (796 lines) and is 4 lines under 800 hard cap, blocking further additions
Three distinct responsibilities are accreted in structured_run.py: run mechanism, cache-effectiveness diagnostics, and failure interpretation, violating single responsibility principle
Decompose structured_run.py by responsibility into three cohesive modules with one-way dependency flow to prevent future re-inflation and keep code within size gates

Cache-effectiveness diagnostics cluster (warn_if_cache_ineffective, cache_write_never_read, etc.) and failure-interpretation cluster (FailureContext, interpret_failure, etc.) must be extracted as separate pure/observability modules without back-edges to orchestrator
Preserve all public import paths via re-exports from structured_run.py so external callers (runner.py, usage_report.py, capabilities.py, tests) remain untouched and no test edits are required
